title: Use a measured material policy response without demanding exact hidden layers
statement: Randomly assign matched patches to fixed mask policies and measure the final response distribution. Under randomization, protocol consistency and no patch interference, a whole-policy causal comparison does not require identifying every defect depth.

requires: Independently prepared comparable patches, randomized assignment, fixed complete fabrication/read protocol, calibrated final observable and no interference.
provides: Randomly assign matched patches to fixed mask policies and measure the final response distribution. Under randomization, protocol consistency and no patch interference, a whole-policy causal comparison does not require identifying every defect depth.
assumptions: No acquired physical policy response/advantage. Preserve proprietary fabrication access, retention/read damage, replicas and ordinary design/comparator costs.
costs: Charge preparation, calibration/registration, actual incident norm/dose including interference and probe tails, every native-state read, other-species damage, time/energy, all failed/reset/replacement/flip trials and independent replicas. Same-information ordinary microscopy, likelihood, Fourier and retry comparators get the same priors/actions. Full-cycle advantage is UNKNOWN.
contract.units: Flux is e/area/time; barn=1e-8 Å²; squared amplitudes/coherent incident power, population mean, first-event probability, defect count, read survival and all-species damage are distinct. Source theoretical/sensitivity parameters are not measured fidelity.
contract.obstruction: No acquired physical policy response/advantage. Preserve proprietary fabrication access, retention/read damage, replicas and ordinary design/comparator costs. Acquire actual source/physical/control/noise contracts and full-cycle comparative costs. Missing source data/code remain explicit, not silently reconstructed. No device, physical advantage or historical priority established; mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

body: Equal action count/dose is not equal finished defect population; isolating geometry needs count/covariance calibration and controls. The source retained column patterns and diffraction provide starting ingredients, but no new physical mask-policy comparison was performed. An empirical distribution does not silently become known couplings or an optimized device.
